note: Equipment: three slots (armour, weapon, mod). An empty weapon slot is the issue rifle (range 6, damage 1, 4-tick shots). Stats: armour = hp/morale/speed; weapon = range/damage/shot_ticks/accuracy (percentage points); mod = a trait. 'tier' is the earliest act an item may be found.

traits.sprinter: diagonal steps cost the same as straight ones
traits.bracing: +2 on the morale check beside cover (instead of +1) and +5 hit chance for its owner's shots from cover
traits.opener: its owner's first shot each round has +15 hit chance

items.name: Compact vest
items.note: Standard issue. Salvage nylon and ceramic; it has stopped worse.

items.name: Mourning cloak
items.note: Sewn from the names of the dead. Nobody who wears it breaks easily.

items.name: Ablative coat
items.note: Hegemony issue, stripped from a depot.

items.name: Gavel's plate
items.note: Taken from an officer who never stepped back.

items.name: Short carbine
items.note: Quick and close: shorter range, faster shots.

items.name: Scatter gun
items.note: Doors and corridors. Hits hard, falls off fast.

items.name: Marksman rifle
items.note: Reaches further and lands more often, at the cost of a slower shot.

items.name: Seal's rifle
items.note: An officer's long gun; still sighted for someone else's eye.

items.name: Salvaged scope
items.note: See further, shoot a little further.

items.name: Bracing stanchion
items.note: A folding rest: steadier and truer behind cover.

items.name: Reflex rig
items.note: The first shot of a round is the best one.
